resources.string: What you upload, the others download wherever they are
Syncs when you are on the same Wi-Fi, free and without servers.
Goes through your cloud: what you upload the others download wherever they are, and it shows on the web. Only changes are uploaded.
No cloud yet: set its address and your key in Sync → Cloud.
Shared chats set to «Cloud» go through your server. Your own chats stay on the local network.
Your server keeps the shared chats that go through the cloud and shows them on the web. Personal chats stay on the local network, without servers.
The address must start with https://.
The key starts with pxn_ (the web gives it to you when you register this device).
Only changes are uploaded: on an annotated plan, the new stroke and not the whole plan.

You annotated this document offline.
Yes: discard those changes (the others' stay).
No: go back online and upload them.
Cancel: keep it offline for next time.
